chain.title: Dielectric Paste
chain.desc: Craft dielectric paste from three coal or charcoal, two clay balls and a lava bucket; it is the binder in every Powah component.

chain.title: Dielectric Casing
chain.desc: Craft the casing from four iron ingots plus vertical and horizontal dielectric rods; it is the core of all Powah machines.

chain.title: Furnator
chain.desc: Craft with a furnace, a dielectric casing, two tiny basic capacitors and dielectric paste; it burns furnace fuel into FE.

chain.title: Thermo Generator
chain.desc: Craft from three thermoelectric plates, a casing and tiny capacitors, then place it over a heat source like lava for passive FE.

chain.title: Energy Cell
chain.desc: Craft the first FE battery block from iron ingots, four tiny basic capacitors and a dielectric casing.

chain.title: Energy Cable
chain.desc: Craft starter cables to pipe FE between your generators, cells and machines.

chain.title: Energizing Orb
chain.desc: Craft from glass, a dielectric casing and horizontal dielectric rods; it is the crafting hub where energizing recipes happen.

chain.title: Energizing Rod
chain.desc: Craft from quartz, two tiny capacitors, a casing and a dielectric rod; place rods near the Orb and power them to energize items.

chain.title: Energized Steel
chain.desc: Energize one iron ingot and one gold ingot in the Orb (10,000 FE) to get two energized steel, the material for the Hardened tier.

chain.title: Blazing Crystal
chain.desc: Energize four blaze powder (120,000 FE) into a blazing crystal, unlocking Blazing-tier machines and capacitors.

chain.title: Niotic Crystal
chain.desc: Energize a single diamond (300,000 FE) into a niotic crystal for the Niotic tier.

chain.title: Spirited Crystal
chain.desc: Energize a single emerald (1,000,000 FE) into a spirited crystal for the Spirited tier.

chain.title: Uraninite
chain.desc: Mine uraninite ore (also in deepslate) and smelt it, or energize raw uraninite (2,000 FE) to double it into uraninite fuel.

chain.title: Uraninite Reactor Block
chain.desc: Craft reactor blocks from dielectric casings, tiny capacitors and uraninite; you need 36 of them for the reactor.

chain.title: Uraninite Reactor
chain.desc: Place 36 reactor blocks to assemble the multiblock reactor, then feed it uraninite (plus optional redstone and coolant) for large FE output.

chain.title: Ender Core
chain.desc: Energize an eye of ender with a dielectric casing and a tiny capacitor (50,000 FE) to make the core for ender energy blocks.

chain.title: Ender Cell
chain.desc: Craft from an ender core, iron and obsidian; ender cells share one wireless energy pool across dimensions via numbered channels.

chain.title: Nitro Crystal
chain.desc: Energize a nether star, two redstone blocks and a blazing crystal block (20,000,000 FE) into 16 nitro crystals, the final tier material.

chain.title: Nitro Energy Cell
chain.desc: Upgrade through the cell tiers using nitro crystals to reach Powah's highest-capacity energy storage.

chain.title: Nitro Thermo Generator
chain.desc: Tier up thermo generators to nitro for the classic endgame passive-power setup over lava or magma blocks.

notes: Tier order Starter->Basic->Hardened->Blazing->Niotic->Spirited->Nitro. Tier materials verified from capacitor recipes: Hardened=energized steel, Blazing=blazing crystal, Niotic=niotic crystal (diamond), Spirited=spirited crystal (emerald), Nitro=nitro crystal (nether star). Energizing FE costs read from data/powah/recipes/energizing/*. All ids set-checked against 144 item models in jar.
